versions.content: If CanNmComUserDataSupport is enabled and NM-PDU is not configured for triggered transmission in CanIf (CanIfTxPduTriggerTransmit set to FALSE) CanNm shall collect the NM User Data from the referenced NM I-PDU by calling PduR_CanNmTriggerTransmit and combine the user data with the further NM bytes each time before it requests the transmission of the corresponding NM PDU.
